title: 2. Consumo energetico
description: Analisis situacional del consumo. El eje temporal es window_start (tiempo de evento). Sigue las metricas habituales de gestion energetica de edificios: perfil de carga, demanda pico, consumo base, factor de carga e intensidad energetica.

list.name: medio
list.label: Tipo de contador
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT meter_type FROM telemetry_metrics ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Demanda pico
panels.description: Maximo consumo agregado en una hora. Es la magnitud por la que las electricas facturan la potencia contratada a un cliente comercial, no solo por la energia consumida.

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT window_start, sum(sum_reading) AS total
  FROM telemetry_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND meter_type = '$medio'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT max(total) AS "pico" FROM h

panels.title: Consumo base
panels.description: Minimo horario: lo que consume el conjunto cuando no hay actividad. Es el diagnostico clasico de consumo fantasma; cuanto mas cerca del pico, mas equipamiento permanentemente encendido.

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT window_start, sum(sum_reading) AS total
  FROM telemetry_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND meter_type = '$medio'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT min(total) AS "base" FROM h

panels.title: Factor de carga
panels.description: Media dividida entre pico. Mide como de bien se aprovecha la potencia contratada: cercano a 1 indica demanda plana, valores bajos indican picos puntuales que encarecen la factura sin aportar consumo.

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT window_start, sum(sum_reading) AS total
  FROM telemetry_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND meter_type = '$medio'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT avg(total) / NULLIF(max(total), 0) AS "factor de carga" FROM h

SELECT max(distinct_buildings) AS "edificios"
FROM (
  SELECT window_start, sum(distinct_buildings) AS distinct_buildings
  FROM telemetry_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND meter_type = '$medio'
  GROUP BY 1
) q

panels.title: Consumo por tipo de contador
panels.description: Series separadas porque las unidades NO son comparables entre medios: sumarlas produciria una cifra sin significado fisico.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(window_start, $__interval),
  meter_type AS metric,
  sum(sum_reading) AS "consumo"
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start)
GROUP BY 1, meter_type
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Perfil de carga por hora del dia
panels.description: El grafico canonico de gestion energetica: como se distribuye el consumo a lo largo del dia. El valle nocturno y el pico de actividad son la firma del uso del edificio.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(hour FROM window_start)::int AS "hora",
  sum(sum_reading) AS "consumo"
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND meter_type = '$medio'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Intensidad energetica por uso de edificio
panels.description: Consumo por pie cuadrado, calculado como cociente de sumas y no como media de cocientes: con superficies de 801 a 850.354 pies cuadrados, promediar cocientes daria mas peso a los edificios pequenos. Es la metrica normalizada estandar para comparar edificios de tamanos distintos.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  primary_use AS "uso",
  sum(sum_reading) / NULLIF(sum(sum_square_feet), 0) AS "intensidad"
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND meter_type = '$medio'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(window_start, $__interval),
  'emplazamiento ' || site_id AS metric,
  sum(sum_reading) AS "consumo"
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND meter_type = '$medio'
GROUP BY 1, site_id
ORDER BY 1
